He opened pull requests in UTMIST/Misty (#254, #255, #256, #263, #265, #267), UTMIST/UTMIST (#484), qiuethan/Portfolio (#1–#6), and qiuethan/now (#1–#3). He also reviewed pull requests in UTMIST/Misty (#206, #221, #230, #233, #241–#253, #258–#264) and UTMIST/UTMIST (#458, #466–#471, #476, #477, #486), and opened issue UTMIST/UTMIST#483.
